title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients: Report

sources.summary: JPMorgan is reportedly expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.
The USD-denominated deposit token now supports peer-to-peer transfers within the Ethereum Virtual Machine ecosystem, including Base.

title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B

title: South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay

sources.summary: Finance officials are reportedly set to meet major crypto exchanges on Tuesday, days after a lawmaker introduced legislation that could push the tax’s start date back two years.

title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds

title: Show HN: WhatsApp MCP running free on Cloudflare

sources.summary:
I wanted my humble Claude on mobile to access my WhatsApp messages but the only options I could find either required WhatsApp Business or an actual server to run Baileys on.

I wanted to run it for free on ClaudeFlare and with my personal WhatsApp account, so I built this.

Important feature - it connects to your Google account as well as WhatsApp to grab the names of all your WhatsApp contacts, otherwise you get only phone numbers for many of them and search doesn't work properly.
